infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Veda reads your calendar to detect upcoming flights and suggest roaming plans before you travel.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Veda uses your location to show local weather on your dashboard.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Veda reads your contacts to help you message, call, and get context for your relationships.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Veda monitors saved locations (home, work, or custom) in the background so it can provide timely, context-aware assistance when you arrive or leave.
